note: Registry data could not be verified. The search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable ('Connection refused'), and fallback engines (Bing, Google, DuckDuckGo HTML) returned only generic 'Aarna' name-meaning pages with no registry or GST hits for 'Aarna Enterprises'. Direct fetches of registry aggregators were blocked: zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, instafinancials.com returned HTTP 403, thecompanycheck.com served only its marketing landing page (search is behind a login). No CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status or audited revenue could be retrieved from a public source, so all such fields are null rather than guessed. The name as given is a bare trade name with no legal suffix (no Pvt Ltd / LLP), which is consistent with a proprietorship or partnership that would have no CIN at all - but this is an inference, not a verified fact. NOT rejected: there is no evidence the entity does not exist; the absence of data is a research limitation, not a negative finding. Note also that the declared HS codes (100610 rice, 850910 electric appliances) span two unrelated product families, which is a classification question for the product team, not a rejection ground under the project rules. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend, or obtain the GSTIN/PAN directly from the supplier, then verify on the GST portal and MCA.
